segments.text: WGit puts a git server in one binary backed by S3 or GCS with no database or elected leader. The bucket is the repository. Each server's disk is just a
disposable cache. Pushes become immutable log entries while a compare and swap manifest decides which update wins, letting multiple instances share
storage safely. It includes smart HTTP policies, web hooks, and a web UI.
